{{Top|leg}}
'''Droid armor''' was the name given to the type of plating installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for the purpose of protection from elements such as heat, cold and physical stress. These barriers, depending on the price a droid owner was prepared to pay, were composed of many different types of materials such as metal alloys, [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], or [[Bronzium/Legends|bronzium]]. There were several varieties of armor available, for example: '''Impact armor''', which was designed to help absorb some of the wear and tear droids could have experienced in an active workplace or '''Modular plating''', which was designed as a lightweight yet durable substitute for heavier, more cumbersome armor.

==Behind the scenes==
It is probable that in most instances droids are equipped with armor, even if it is not specified. Droid armor gains significance primarily as game mechanics.
